en.html:
The moment his mouth was free, the man began asking. Then stopped. Which question first, probably.

I understood. Unfortunately, the answer was not ready with me either. Explain what? Begin where?

Leaving quietly would have suited me. But these people had been dragged into it for no fault of theirs. I could not simply walk away. Whether they could accept it or not, I owed them an honest explanation.

Only... what explanation?

en.html:
The ropes. The boy's wound. The fallen dragoons. She showed them all of it.

She was right.

Only the essential points. Too direct, difficult to accept—but all true. Nothing in those words to forget, nothing to misunderstand.

If they could not accept it now, that was all right. The tension outside would make them understand. War was happening. They would remember her words then, and know she had warned them what to do.

Fight, or run.

Everyone had to think about that. Decide nothing, and be swept in and killed—if they wanted to avoid that, they had to think.

I left the family with Ichijou and looked elsewhere.

全てを示して、一条はそう言った。
　
　正しい。

　一条は要点しか語っていない。
　端的に過ぎ、受け入れるのは困難だ――が。それは
全て真実であり、忘れようも誤解のしようもないほど
簡明である。

　今は納得が得られなくてもいい。
　世情の緊張はいずれ彼らに『戦争』の事実を理解さ
せる。そして一条の言葉を思い出すだろう。いま何を
すべきなのか、その忠告を受けていたと知るだろう。

　――戦うのか。逃げるのか。
　確かにそれは誰もが考えねばならないことだ。何も
決断しないままただ巻き込まれて命を失わぬために。

　一家の相手は一条に任せることにして、俺は視線を
転じた。

en.html:
Their last bed was the café's cold floor.

Nine people who had served Raichou Imagawa.

No particular sympathy came to me. They had played with other people's lives. Some reason of their own, perhaps. That did not make it forgivable. Losing their own lives in return—what else could they expect?

That was what I thought.
For the same reason, no pity.

Nor did I blame Ichijou. If they had committed crimes deserving death, then she had only carried out the sentence.

Another solution, I could hardly imagine. A warrior could lose limbs and keep fighting. Could grow those limbs back. Without killing, to take away only the ability to fight—that was not a simple task.

Haath kaato, phir haath aa jaayega. Cut off a hand, and another hand will come. Kindly wait for the enemy to finish repairing himself, then explain once more that he has been defeated. Meanwhile, three hostages whose throats would not repair themselves were still there. Such generosity with somebody else's risk, we could not afford.

Had Ichijou tried it and failed, the hostages would have died at once. Aim at the vital points. Kill with one strike. Her decision was not wrong. I could say that firmly.

Nothing to regret.
Nothing to be ashamed of.
Nothing to go back over and torment myself with.

Yes. I could say that.
I could.

She was still speaking with the family.

...Not with either parent now, it seemed. With the boy. Perhaps, of the three, he had adjusted fastest.

ja.html:
喫茶店の冷たい床を<ruby>終<rt>つい</rt></ruby>の寝台とする彼ら。
　今川雷蝶に仕えていた九人。

　同情の念は、格別ない。
　彼らは他者の生命を弄んだ。彼らなりにそうすべき
理由があったとしても、それは許されぬ行為である。
結果として己の生命を失ったのはむしろ当然だ。

　そう思う。
　同じ理由で、憐憫の情もない。

　一条を責める想いもなかった。
　彼らが死に値する罪を犯していたなら、一条は単に
その執行を担ったに過ぎないのだと思う。

　他に解決方法があったとも考え難い。
　武者は手足を断たれても行動を続行できる耐久力と、
その手足を再生させる回復力の所有者だ。殺さず戦闘
力だけ奪うのは容易ならぬ事である。

　一条がもしそうしようと試み、そして失敗していた
ら、人質は即座に殺されていただろう。
　敵の急所を狙って一撃必殺に仕留めた一条の判断は
間違っていない。そう断定できる。

　つまり、何も悔やむ事はない。
　恥じる事もない。
　省みて、思い悩むべき何事もない。

　そう云える。
　云えるのだ。
　
　一条と一家の対話は続いていた。

　……どういうわけか相手は両親のどちらでもなく、
男児に代わったらしい。
　一家の内で最も順応力が高かったのがその子だった、
という事だろうか。

en.html:
Child Hostage"War?"
Ichijou"Mm."
Child Hostage"Why?"
Ichijou"Can't forgive the bad people."
Child Hostage"Rokuhara?"
Ichijou"Yes. You know about them."
Child Hostage"Osaka..."
Ichijou"...The Osaka massacre?"
Child Hostage"Everyone died. So much fire."
Child Hostage"Then we came here."
Ichijou"............I see."
Child Hostage"You're fighting them?"
Ichijou"Yes."
Child Hostage"Why?"
Ichijou"Because I believe that's justice."
Child Hostage"...Justice."
Ichijou"Living straight. Doing what's right. Not forgiving the bad people."
Child Hostage"You're not scared?"
Ichijou"Hmm. A little, yes."
Child Hostage"Still you fight?"
Ichijou"Haan."
Child Hostage"Why?"
Ichijou"That's courage."
